title: Karnataka Postal Circle to sell 8,000 philately passports on October 10 and 11
summary: The Karnataka Postal Circle will issue 8,000 philately passports on October 10 and 11, with 1,500 to be sold in Bengaluru’s GPO and the rest spread across Mangaluru, Mysuru, and Belagavi in a first-come, first-served process, as part of National Postal Week.

title: Byelection outcome a ‘temporary victory for politics of betrayal’, says Stalin
summary: He says the votes polled by the parties that contested against the ruling TVK shows that it has been rejected by a majority of voters

title: No surprises in byelection results in Tamil Nadu and  Puducherry as voters favour the ruling party candidates
summary: The Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam bags the Madurantakam and Dharapuram (Reserved) Assembly constituencies. In Puducherry, the All India N.R. Congress retains Thattanchavady

title: Family rejection, hunger and a court battle: Hyderabad’s Ruth John Paul becomes India’s first transgender PG doctor
summary: “I am feeling very happy. It is a matter of pride for me and my community. It is a great achievement in my life,” says  Ruth John Paul

title: AIADMK likely to face another crisis after decline in vote share
summary: Following AIADMK’s recent setback in the Madurantakam and Dharapuram bypoll, detractors may raise questions about Edappadi K. Palaniswami’s leadership around the time of the party’s Foundation Day on October 17

title: TVK allies hail byelection victory, says its an endorsement of government’s performance
summary: Alliance leaders including Thirumavalavan and Manickam Tagore congratulate the party on its electoral success

title: Maragatham Kumaravel romps home in Madurantakam, this time on TVK ticket
summary: She defeats her nearest rival, I. Paranthamen of the DMK, by a margin of 20,040 votes. The counting process was by and large incident free

title: 11-year-old tribal student of Thane ashram school dies after fever; three officials suspended
summary: Vivek Subhash Bhoye, a Class 5 student, died in Maharashtra’s Thane district after the school allegedly delayed informing his mother and failed to provide timely medical treatment
